headline_marked: BNP worker [[killed in Sabujbagh]] after dispute over stolen rickshaw
headline: BNP worker killed in Sabujbagh after dispute over stolen rickshaw
summary: Ibrahim Palash, a 36-year-old private car driver and local BNP worker, was hacked to death by a group of 10-12 people in Dhaka.
details: Ibrahim Palash (36) was hacked to death on Tuesday night near the Rajarbagh Bazar water pump area in Sabujbagh, Dhaka.
A group of 10 to 12 attackers, including individuals identified as Royal, Sabuj, and Nayem, attacked Palash with sharp weapons while he was sitting at a tea stall.
The attackers inflicted severe injuries, including cutting off both of his wrists and striking him twice in the chest, before fleeing the scene.
Palash was rushed to Mugda General Hospital and later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared him dead at 9:30 PM.
According to a neighbor, the attack was allegedly triggered by a dispute over a stolen rickshaw that Palash had attempted to recover from a local garage.
The body is currently kept at the Dhaka Medical College Hospital morgue, and the police have been notified of the incident.
caption:
A BNP worker was hacked to death in Dhaka's Sabujbagh after a dispute over a stolen rickshaw.

Ibrahim Palash (36) was hacked to death on Tuesday night near the Rajarbagh Bazar water pump area in Sabujbagh, Dhaka.

A group of 10 to 12 attackers, including individuals identified as Royal, Sabuj, and Nayem, attacked Palash with sharp weapons while he was sitting at a tea stall.

The attackers inflicted severe injuries, including cutting off both of his wrists and striking him twice in the chest, before fleeing the scene.

Palash was rushed to Mugda General Hospital and later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared him dead at 9:30 PM.

According to a neighbor, the attack was allegedly triggered by a dispute over a stolen rickshaw that Palash had attempted to recover from a local garage.

The body is currently kept at the Dhaka Medical College Hospital morgue, and the police have been notified of the incident.
